source.absorbed_from: directing-stickman-videos style-catalog Style 2A Modern Beanie Studio Tech

lens_aspect.focal: flat 2D orthographic with subtle floor-perspective grid
lens_aspect.notes: 高光纯白空间 + 浅灰透视地砖网格

rules: 16:9: stage action across left, center, and right, lateral tracking, deliberate negative space
9:16: foreground/background depth, stacked motion, vertical reveals, foreground passes, interface-safe overlay space
subject centered with clean white negative space around
composition.zh: 横屏左右调度，竖屏纵深堆叠；大量纯白负空间

rules: high-key studio lighting, clean white negative space
sleek glowing cyan and electric blue glass holographic UI elements
no harsh shadows, no cinematic volumetric haze
lighting.zh: 高光棚拍 + 青蓝玻璃全息 UI，无硬阴影

rules: pure white high-key studio with subtle light-gray perspective grid lines on the floor plane
glowing cyan and electric blue glass holographic UI elements
figure wears bright red beanie (smooth rounded knit, no pom-pom) and yellow t-shirt, black stick limbs and shorts
maximum three saturated accent colors named with ordinary words
no technical color notation (hex, RGB, Pantone) in generation prompts
color.zh: 纯白高光棚 + 浅灰网格 + 青蓝玻璃 UI + 红帽黄衫火柴人

rules: physical character-driven interactions: leaping and bumping an invisible glass ceiling, tapping a sneaker on the floor grid to emit expanding cyan ripple, pulling a glowing light-pen to draw a luminous line bridge, touching a floating glass panel to reveal an icon-only lock, pushing open a heavy minimalist vault door
no abstract liquid or object morphing
rapid scene changes, kinetic motion-graphic transformations, frequent visual events while preserving identical figure design and constant line weight
motion.zh: 角色驱动物理交互，禁止抽象液态变形

rhythm.cut_rule: one 10s clip = three timed beats [0-3s][3-7s][7-10s]; visual change every 2-3 seconds; never idle or staring at camera
rhythm.zh: 10 秒一段三节拍，每 2-3 秒有视觉变化

signature.en: modern bright white studio space with subtle light-gray perspective grid lines on the floor plane, high-key studio lighting, clean white negative space
signature.zh: 纯白高光棚 + 浅灰透视地砖网格

signature.en: sleek glowing cyan and electric blue glass holographic UI elements floating in clean white negative space
signature.zh: 悬浮青蓝玻璃全息 UI

signature.en: minimalist 2D animated stick figure wearing a bright red beanie (smooth rounded knit, no pom-pom) and a yellow t-shirt, with simple black stick limbs and shorts
signature.zh: 红帽黄衫火柴人（无绒球）

negative: visible words, letters, numbers, captions, subtitles, interface copy, logos, watermarks

anime_safe.notes: 2D 线稿角色 + 极简棚拍，与非写实画风兼容

rules: use foreground/background depth instead of left-right staging
stack motion vertically; reveal downward or upward
keep overlay text in the interface-safe upper/lower band
switch the composition axis to the vertical center line
vertical_9x16.note: 竖屏必须重构构图而非改比例标签

grade.description: high-key white studio, clean contrast, subtle cyan/blue tint

line_weight: simple black lines, uniform stroke, vibrant 2D animation
character_dna: A minimalist 2D animated stick figure wearing a bright red beanie (smooth rounded knit, no pom-pom) and a yellow t-shirt, with simple black stick limbs and shorts. Simple black lines, vibrant colors, smooth 2D animation style.
